question.content:
$f(x)=\dfrac{1}{1-2x}$

We know that

$f(x)=1+2x+{{(2x)}^{2}}+{{(2x)}^{3}}+...+{{(2x)}^{n}}+...$

for $x\in \left(-\dfrac12,\dfrac12\right)$.

**Using this fact, find the power series for $g(x)=\dfrac{2}{(1-2x)^2}$.**
